C0147.title: Xiangtan Police Crack Case Involving Stolen Online Accounts Sold for Profit
keywords: Ministry of Public Security typical case
C0147.summary: In March 2025, China's Ministry of Public Security announced ten typical cases from its campaign against crimes involving citizens' personal information, including a case handled by Xiangtan police in Hunan. Cyber police found that since December 2022, a group led by Feng and Tan Hong had posted false promotional videos on short-video platforms offering free red envelopes and game skins, tricking victims into handing over online accounts and then selling those accounts for profit. In August 2024, police arrested 35 suspects, seized more than 6,000 stolen online accounts, and identified over 2 million yuan in case value.
